subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `AgentToolResult.control` plus `canYield: true` as the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for plugin-owned asynchronous interaction handoffs?
rationale: The patch is mechanically reviewed and proof-positive, but deciding whether this generic control belongs in the long-lived Plugin SDK—and what compatibility obligation its catalog and runtime semantics create—requires owner intent rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Accept the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Approve the opt-in yield control with its required sequential declaration and explicit unsupported-runtime errors, then merge after the exact head remains green.

options.title: Keep the capability internal for now
options.body: Decline the public SDK export and pursue any first-party interaction workflow through a narrower owner-controlled API instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in yield control with its required sequential declaration and explicit unsupported-runtime errors, then merge after the exact head remains green.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed control deliberately reuses the existing `sessions_yield` lifecycle, so this is the closest identified owner for the runtime and API-direction decision.
